Verification: U unit, KAT or oracle test; F fuzz or property test; I interop; L lab; G gate row; A real-device comparison.

| KS-RRC-B2 | 2026-10-15 | Typed RRC builders and readers as built in P1 N6 (src/codec/asn1/msg/rrc). A message is a plain struct; encode() checks its inputs, builds the value as X.697 JSON and lets the generated asn1c code produce strict UPER (JER in, so every ASN.1 constraint is applied by the same code that decodes); readers decode UPER, render JER and read the fields P1 interprets. The JSON is nlohmann ordered_json because asn1c's JER decoder (mouse07410 18e56503) requires SEQUENCE members in definition order and rejects a value whose keys are sorted; it reads hex in either case. A fixed-size BIT STRING is the hex of its left-aligned octets. Covered: MIB, SIB1 (cell access info, UE timers), Paging, RRCSetupRequest, RRCSetup, RRCReject, SecurityModeCommand/Complete/Failure, RRCReconfiguration (radio bearers, masterCellGroup, NAS list) and its Complete, RRCRelease, UECapabilityEnquiry/Information, DL/ULInformationTransfer, CellGroupConfig (RLC bearers only) and a generic UE-NR-Capability | src/codec/asn1/msg/rrc.cpp; tests/unit/asn1/rrc_msg_test.cpp; P1 N6 |
